en: Now to conclude this section here,
there's one special extension
I wanna show you that could also be
interesting to you if you do wanna handle
different responses and if you don't
necessarily have access to the backend code
or if you don't wanna change it. So if you
can't set headers like this, for example.
Therefore, I'll comment them out here.
Because HTMX offers the Response Targets
extension.
This is an extension which you can add to
your project, which then allows you to
specify different targets with attributes,
so in the client-side code, for different
response status codes.
And that allows us to at least work around
this Retarget header here.
Now to add this extension, we could include
it from a CDN
or
we again
just grab the extension code,
copy it,
and then add a new file in the public
folder,
htmx-response-targets.js, for example, and
we paste that code in there.
And then we need to make sure that this file
gets included. So in app.js,
